svg.title: STOP OVERCOMPLICATING CONDITIONING.
svg.desc: TRY 10 CONTROLLED REPS. BUILD FROM THERE. Choose your variation. Use smaller sets or start with fewer reps. Build gradually and allow recovery between sessions.
